principle: An open license makes an asset reusable, not visually valid. Every lead still needs spontaneous naming evidence before activation.

items.preferredForm: small mound or pile of earth/sand, mound visually dominant
items.contextualCue: a shovel may help disambiguate the mound but contributes no sound
items.nextAction: continue open-source search; do not manufacture a validated-looking asset from unrelated parts

items.preferredForm: Earth-specific blue-green globe with recognizable continents; avoid generic wireframe globe when possible

assetLeads.title: Earth clipart.svg
assetLeads.caveat: open and Earth-specific, but spontaneous naming may still be planète or monde rather than Terre

assetLeads.title: Globe.svg
assetLeads.caveat: description explicitly identifies Earth; provenance/license metadata must be captured exactly before importing the asset

assetLeads.title: Globe icon.svg
assetLeads.caveat: schematic globe may elicit globe or monde and is therefore a useful negative/comparison stimulus, not a validated Terre pictogram

rejectedShortcuts: reuse terre-v1 soil/mound/clod stimuli as evidence for planet Terre
treat any generic globe icon as automatically reading Terre
items.nextAction: prepare terre-v2 planet-only naming comparison and ask for spontaneous first response before activation

items.preferredForm: empty clay flowerpot with the container dominating the image

assetLeads.title: Vector flowerpot.svg
assetLeads.author: BoxOfNotes
assetLeads.caveat: license and provenance are suitable for study; naming as pot still requires a fresh human test

assetLeads.title: Flower-and-flowerpot.svg
assetLeads.author: hatalar205
assetLeads.caveat: the flower may dominate spontaneous naming, so compare against the empty-pot candidate

items.nextAction: compare empty pot versus flower-and-pot in a fresh pot-v4 naming revision

items.preferredForm: a note whose staff position unambiguously denotes do in the chosen convention

assetLeads.title: Grand staff labeled notes.svg
assetLeads.caveat: use to study note placement; a labeled educational diagram is not itself a clean rebus pictogram

assetLeads.title: Music Staff.svg
assetLeads.caveat: staff alone has no do reading and must never be counted as phonetic evidence

items.nextAction: define an explicit do-placement stimulus and test whether people answer do rather than note or musique; keep dos separate
